about_the_game:
Brave the cursed waters with up to 3 friends as you seek forbidden treasures for the mysterious Black Armada. Will you survive what lurks beneath the waves?

• Chart your course through cursed waters, but beware - these islands hold dark secrets

• Your lantern is your lifeline in the darkness - use it wisely, or face what hungers in the shadows

• Race against time to claim ancient treasures, if you dare to venture deep enough

• Feel the terror mount as your teammates' voices fade into the distance

• Keep your ship afloat together, or join the countless wrecks in the cursed depths

In these cursed waters, your ship is your only hope of survival. But the Black Armada demands more... Will you risk it all and venture deeper, where priceless treasures await - along with unspeakable horrors?

• Lurking Horrors: Every creak, every shadow, every whisper in the dark could be your last warning

• Your Vessel: Your only refuge in these cursed waters - keep it intact, or face the horrors of the deep

• Ancient Secrets: Survive each voyage to unlock darker waters and greater rewards - if you dare to return


Will your crew stand united against the horrors that lurk below, or will the dark waters claim yet another vessel? In these cursed seas, death is merely the beginning.

content_descriptors.notes: Merchants of Dark includes mild violence, frightening scenes, and dark themes. Players will encounter skeletons, corpses, and tense, eerie settings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Sail cursed waters to hunt valuable artifacts from cursed islands. Manage your ship, explore dangerous ruins, and deliver treasures to the Armada Guild before darkness claims you.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
